items.title: Albert "June" Gardner Interview, 1996-04-17
items.q: Well Tex, I'm going to talk to your cousin Tex. Yeah, Tex Stevens, yeah.

ctx.x: Hauling them, stuff up in the holes, sacks, oyster shells. I did this with my father-in-law, this was in between jobs, music when I was married. So it's been quite a few other jobs that I've had other than music, but music has been my lifelong work. But it was a thing called survival. Like I said, you're a man first, you're a musician second.
Well Tex, I'm going to talk to your cousin Tex. Yeah, Tex Stevens, yeah. He gave me a litany of jobs. I didn't. Tex gave me a litany of jobs he had.
